top_predictions.display_label: Corn Cercospora Leaf Spot Gray Leaf Spot

summary: Likely fungal disease symptoms were detected.
treatment: Remove infected leaves and destroy them away from the field.
Apply a crop-appropriate fungicide if disease pressure is increasing.
control: Improve spacing, pruning, and airflow around plants.
Water at soil level and avoid wetting foliage.
prevention: Rotate crops and avoid planting susceptible crops in the same location repeatedly.
Sanitize stakes, trays, and tools between seasons.
caution: Use local extension guidance before applying pesticides or removing plants.
